residual_risks: Criteria source was AGENTS.md only (CLAUDE.md is an include of it; no CODING_STANDARDS.md). Every applicable section was checked against the two changed files and no written rule is mechanically violated: 'Code guidelines' (no window.setTimeout/requestAnimationFrame, no React.useCallback or React.useLayoutEffect added; FieldControl.tsx:99 and :119 use useIsoLayoutEffect, :120 keeps activeElement(ownerDocument(...))), 'Linting, typechecking, and formatting' (no casts added; the exported FieldControlProps interface and its JSDoc at FieldControl.tsx:187-195 are unchanged, so the 'run pnpm docs:api' rule is not triggered), 'Testing' (no flushMicrotasks after render, no waitFor, Vitest-only matchers, tests colocated in FieldControl.test.tsx), 'Commit guidelines' (subject '[field] Sync controlled value changes with field state' matches '[scope] Imperative summary'), 'Errors' (no Error constructors touched). eslint, prettier and tsc were not run in this review (read-only clone, no installs), so the 'Ensure your changes pass linting / are formatted' rules are unverified here and left to CI.

PR body and code disagree in three places; no AGENTS.md rule governs PR descriptions, so these are recorded here rather than as standards findings. (1) The body's open question says the PR does not call clearErrors on a controlled value change, but FieldControl.tsx:110 calls `clearErrors(name);` inside the useValueChanged callback, so a programmatic change now clears a Form server error. (2) The body says 'A control that unmounts or becomes disabled while focused no longer latches data-focused', but the reviewed head has no such code: setFocused is only called at FieldControl.tsx:121, :159 and :163, as before. (3) The body describes a `processedValueRef` echo guard; `git grep processedValueRef` at head returns nothing, and the code instead returns early from onChange when controlled (FieldControl.tsx:144-146), which also skips the `event.nativeEvent.defaultPrevented` and `details.isCanceled` checks on the controlled path.
testing_gaps: AGENTS.md 'Testing': 'If you made changes to the source code, ensure you verify your changes by running tests (see above), and writing new tests where applicable.' The new controlled-sync branch calls `clearErrors(name)` (FieldControl.tsx:110) and no test asserts it: the only server-error test in FieldControl.test.tsx (line 203, 'does not clear errors or validate when change is prevented') renders an uncontrolled control. A test with `<Form errors={...}>` plus a controlled Field.Control whose value is set from a button would pin whichever answer the PR's open question settles on.

Same AGENTS.md rule: the `details.cancel()` test (FieldControl.test.tsx:189) and the prevented-change test (line 203) both use an uncontrolled control. In controlled mode onChange returns at FieldControl.tsx:144-146 before the `defaultPrevented` / `isCanceled` check at line 153, so a controlled consumer that calls `details.cancel()` (or whose input event is default-prevented) and still updates `value` is untested.
